items.note: S2.4 states the three-stage signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with all scratch restored; S2.3 gives the net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, S2.4.1/S2.4.2 the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, S2.4.3 the three stages, matching the proof at 741-765. The constants h=100, N, m and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are never given, and S2.3 misdescribes which rows are undone (listed as an error).

S2.5 states invertible frames common to a gate, commutation with pointwise linear gates, and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} (eq. 814-816). It is an infer step without method or sub-steps, and the per-route consequence eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is used later (S2.7.4, S2.10.3.2) rather than stated here.

Correct conclusions are stated: the only decreasing edges are the central 3->4 edges losing h, L=Ich, the sum of absolute changes Wm-2N+2L, and L/N=100/539, 101/539 < 1/2. But the label space itself (F^{⊗3} with the form x^T(I-J/9)y over Q, or the F_2 dot product), the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines that makes side-wire labels nest (1048-1060), the gate-label table (975-988), the residual table (1021-1043) and the F_2 orthonormal-basis claim (1073-1102) are absent. S2.6 also calls Wm-2N+2L the 'sum of edge dimension changes', which is the signed sum's value plus 2L, not the signed sum.

It states projection frames with -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m giving the shear H<-H+D on every role. The sub-steps follow the proof at 1156-1172: rank of P_V-P_U equals the dimension change, the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, and the deficit N-2L_b.

It states the frames C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and C^{⊗m} on every role. The sub-steps reproduce weight additivity mod 4, the phase-to-kernel formula, the count and the X_a->Y_a correction with C=iZC^{-1}Z. Left out: the Hadamard conjugation of (-1)^{v·x} into X_v, the endpoint facts that the zero label has frame I and the full label frame C^{⊗m} (q_F=wt, 1287-1289), and the final negation and un-exchange (1311-1314). Judged partial conservatively.

L/N<1/2 gives the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, so s<Wm. S2.9.1 states the exact eta_b, eta_c and that both exceed 20*2^{-50}; S2.9.2 uses log m<20 and the exponential inequality; S2.9.3 concludes s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This is the route at 1319-1346.

S2.1 lists the four O(V) elementary operations of lem:elementary-streams. S2.2 states controlled shifts and unit scalings modulo q^b in O(V), with the b^{O(1)} offset condition carried by its quote at line 566. Both are infer steps, and the split-and-merge proofs at 513-550 and 574-621 are not reconstructed.

It states A=E_1 Pi E_2 by pivoting on the topmost nonzero row and its rightmost entry, and the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V). The sub-steps match 1425-1446: lower-triangular updates in descending order by controlled shifts, conjugation by the factors, and one interchange per pivot via D<-D+H, swap, D<-H-D. The choice of the fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators (1413-1423) is only implicit in 'over Z/q^b'.

It follows the proof at 1491-1616 throughout: the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, shear frames giving Phi_{I_m}, interchange by D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, exactly s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric-sum case split, F_k=O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule as the O(1) term.

It states the O(Vu^tau) interchange and reproduces the proof: top rho=O(log e) digits as a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, base-m pieces with sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and binary padding to [q^e]. The unequal-width remark (1740-1762) is not covered here but appears for axis moves in S5.5.4.

It reproduces the route at 1848-1940: the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} with M only invertible, inverse children through (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f} C^{⊗f} Z^{⊗f}, exactly s_c child calls on the f=e/m axes of one slot, a fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The slot/column layout (1867-1876) is described only briefly.

The sub-steps follow 2013-2231: eight conditional additions with the two parity cycles, guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11 with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B repaired by radix sort, at most sixteen swaps and eight rotations, the family-bound simplification, and the O(V((eK)^tau+1)) basis-change cost. The separate final XOR at j_{f-1} is not mentioned.

It reproduces the node overhead, the q_0 row index padded to multiples of W^{k_0}, the role split giving V/W children, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), the internal sum O(e^lambda), the leaf bound O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). This matches 2286-2448.

It states one exact H_0^{⊗D} layer, one truncation, O(Vd^{lambda'}) time and error <sqrt2 2^{-p}. The guard-width argument follows 2511-2586: A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p). The proof's disk and truncation step (2751-2757) is in S2.11.18.

It covers omega_t=y^{2r/t}, character cancellation via y^{r j_0}=-1, F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, DIF producing B_t F_t^- and the reversed F_t^+B_t^{-1}, grouping into H and J_E, and the layout with prefix moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}) and l simultaneous rounds. The truncation commutation and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} are included, following 2819-3200.

It reproduces evaluation at B_0=2^{4p} with carries in {-1,0}, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centered extraction with carry in {0,1}, the numerators ac-be and ae+bc with negacyclic wrap, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost from four products, as in 3233-3368.

It states M_r=(f*g)/T with error <sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the stated cost. The proof steps match 3414-3495: the normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), the error 2delta+eta then 3delta+eta scaled by M, and M=T/r products.

The identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, error <p^2, time O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha) and the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 are stated, and the derivation follows 3576-3689 and 3836-3889. The permutations themselves, (P_s u)_j=u_{tj} and (P_t v)_k=v_{-sk}, are never defined, and the hypotheses (gcd(s,t)=1, 2<=alpha<sqrt p) are only partly given (theta>p/alpha^4 in S5.2).

S5.6 gives the chirp a_j and the coefficient computation that identifies QF_t, including Q. S5.7 gives the cancellation R F_s^+[(RF_s u)·(RF_s v)]=u*v/S^2 by F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+, commutation with pointwise products and the convolution rule, exactly as 3938-3987. S6.5.4 gives the conjugation.

The sizes, comparison constants, prime intervals with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} prime search and the absence of wraparound are derived as in 4049-4193. The fixed list in S6.1.1 omits lambda=1-2^{-52} and delta=1/16, alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}) and gamma<=b/4 are never defined here, and the verification that the exponents satisfy the layer conditions (4018-4036) is only asserted ('room to spare').

It states Phi with mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the isomorphism argument, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j, the update order i=d..1 with padding fixed, and cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), matching 4204-4292.

Theta: x_d->zeta y is shown diagonal and isometric. The wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j gives M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=f*g/T, and the computed twist errors (each <4) appear in S6.13.3.

It gives the source transform (A, chirp by twisted convolution, B_0, 2^gamma) with exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate F^+, the six algorithm steps, and why the two scales by S undo (u*v)/S^2, as at 4454-4544. The input scaling 2^{-b-2} of the digits is only implicit ('scaled digit streams', 2^{2b+4} undoing the two input scales).

The error chain E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL, then <6TL, then <8TL, then E_s=9*2^gamma TL, then (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), and E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L leads to the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2. Rounding uniqueness and the carry bounds and invariant all match 4557-4794.

Margins g_1..g_7, min g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa, absorption of fixed powers of log p, O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) and the schoolbook cutoff are all stated correctly. The separate argument that setup across recursion visits and exceptional-address sorting across all calls cost o(V) (4913-4981) is absent, and only some table rows are derived in S6.14. Judged partial conservatively.

S0 only lists 'nlogn-conjecture' among its dependencies and motivates the work by the Theta(n log n) scanning cost. No step states the eventual lower bound, its negation via liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, or why the bound refutes it.

errors.says: The scratch restoration works by subtracting the effect of the unknown scratch contents, adding the real contribution, and then undoing the first step.
errors.paper: Rows 0-1 subtract J a + R c and are never undone. Rows 2-3 load the sources into the scratch (copy, gather), rows 4-5 add, and rows 6-7 undo gather and copy (rows 3 and 2), restoring c and a. Undoing the first step (the subtraction) would cancel the scratch correction.

errors.says: The sum of edge dimension changes is Wm-2N+2L (the method adds 'the dimension changes by telescoping at the gates').
errors.paper: Telescoping gives the signed sum Wm-2N. Wm-2N+2L is the sum of absolute changes, obtained by adding 2L for the decreasing edges. S2.6.4 states this correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. The rank-saving network (S2.4-S2.9) feeds the chunk interchange (S2.10) and the simultaneous layer (S2.11). These drive the synthetic transforms and convolution (S3-S4), the Gaussian resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation (S5), and finally the CRT layout, exact recovery and time accounting (S6) that give O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins at the start of the saving: the label construction (bilinear forms, neighbouring-triple orthogonality, gate-label and residual tables) is asserted in S2.6.2 rather than built, and the network constants h=100, N, m=h^3 never appear. The final accounting also omits the o(V) setup and exceptional-sorting argument.

steps.note: S2.4 gives a fixed network on banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets realising (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire, with the coefficient and three-stage argument. The parameters h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated, so this verdict is generous on the numeric content.
S2.5: a frame common to all wires of a gate commutes with pointwise linear gates, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and only edge changes of frame cost work.

S2.6/S2.6.2 give nested nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional space built by tensoring triple indicator lines, comparable on every edge, with the only decreases on the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h. The space F^{⊗3} and its bilinear form are not named.
S2.7.1 states that for nested U⊂V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U. S2.7.2 gives the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
S2.6.4 gives sum|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and S2.7.3 gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
S2.6.5 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2. S2.7.3 gives the deficit N-2L_b>0 and S2.8.3 the deficit 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
S2.7.4: P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on X_a, zero source and identity sink elsewhere, so the same shear H<-H+D on every role. S2.10.3.2 restates it as Phi_{I_m} on every row, scratch included.
S2.10.1 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2. S2.10.2 gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V), with one interchange per pivot in S2.10.2.3. S2.10.3.4 concludes exactly s recursive calls per node.

Children of volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) are given in S2.10.3.1 and S2.10.3.5. S2.9.1-S2.9.3 derive s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20. The geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau) (S2.10.3.6-S2.10.3.8).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain from the bank-exchange network through frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict saving L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear identity and the shear factorization to the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Its weak points are at the start. The numeric parameters h=100, N and m=h^3 are absent, and the label space and its orthogonality are asserted rather than constructed.
